draft.text: You came in because you hurt your left knee while running with your niece a week ago.
You heard a pop and now have pain, swelling, and instability in your knee.
Your knee is swollen and feels warm to the touch.
You have trouble putting weight on it and have been limping.
You have a recent injury to your left knee, which is causing pain, swelling, and instability.
You will need to follow up with your doctor for more instructions.
Any changes in your symptoms should be reported.
